The Player+ redefines golf tech. With a touchscreen display, GPS
access to 42,000+ courses, and studio-quality sound, it’s your
caddie and speaker in one. The built-in magnet lets you mount it anywhere — your cart, bag, or post — and the waterproof, shock-resistant design means it’s built for any condition.

settings.faq_que: What makes the Player+ different than other GPS devices?
settings.faq_ans: Most golf GPS devices only do one thing — give you yardages. Player+ goes further by combining tour-level GPS data, a premium studio quality Bluetooth speaker, a built-in power bank, and other functions into one sleek device. Instead of carrying multiple gadgets, you get accurate distances, immersive sound, and a way to charge your phone — all in one. It’s designed to simplify your round while making it more fun.
No. Yardages, hazards, and 42,000+ courses are included. Membership is optional for advanced analytics.

settings.faq_que: How accurate is it compared to a Rangefinder?
settings.faq_ans: Lasers are exact to the pin. The Player+ gives front, center, back, and hazard distances for smarter              course management. They’re perfect together.
42,000+ courses worldwide, powered by the GAME app. If your course isn’t covered, we’ll add it.

settings.faq_que: How long does the battery last?
settings.faq_ans: 10+ hours - more than enough for a full day of golf.
Yes. IPX7 waterproof and rugged enough for cart, bag, and everyday use.

settings.faq_que: Why not just use a phone app?
settings.faq_ans: Phone apps drain battery, distract you with notifications, and rely on less accurate GPS. Player+ is              purpose-built for golf: it delivers precise yardages, lasts a full round, and automatically tracks your              stats with the GAME app—plus it doubles as a premium speaker, so you get music and performance in one              device.
100-day money-back guarantee + 1-year warranty. Try it risk-free.
